running: one console shown
running: the others run unseen

the head's views of its displays
running and dark as the head's attachment
a display that goes dark but stays connected keeps the head's sessions
dark: under keep, the default, the sessions run on unseen
dark: the keys that reach the head still type into it

transition hangup, at once

transition hangup: the time runs out

transition hangup: the head's sessions hang up

transition oneshot: a console's program exits and the console ends
ended: every console's program has ended
ended: each console shows Session ended. It will not start again.
